notes.title: Version 0.07: The Music Update!
notes.content:
[b]New Content[/b]
[list]
[*] Added 5 new music tracks that play in menus, battles, item rooms, and in the boss room.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where Black Cat's item description wasn't displaying correctly for negative values.
[*] Fixed a bug where Communism wasn't being taken if you took it in the second devil slot.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.06: The Anthropoid Update!
notes.content:
[b]New Content[/b]
[list]
[*] Added 9 new items: [spoiler]Dirty Money, Wet Money, Bankruptcy, Witch, Coach, Zookeeper, Hitman, Husbando, and Black Cat[/spoiler].
[*] Added 2 new Devil items: [spoiler]Capitalism and Communism[/spoiler].
[/list]

[b]Balancing[/b]
[list]
[*] Changed Sloth to now [spoiler]give a x2 damage up[/spoiler].
[*] Changed Nails to now [spoiler]stack and provide a +0.5 damage upgrade to B-Ball Bats instead of the previous +1 damage upgrade[/spoiler].
[*] Changed Tofu to now [spoiler]work 50% of the time instead of 100% of the time[/spoiler].
[*] Removed the Skip Button in endless runs for now as it is too unstable and causing crashing.
[*] I accidentally deleted the enemy E-ghost. R.I.P.
[*] Lowered the opacity of body pillows.
[*] Slightly altered coin rates.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where Snake was doing more damage than it should have.
[*] Fixed a bug where some Active Items were not recharging fully when picked up.
[*] Fixed a bug where item descriptions in the Devil Room were getting cut off.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.05: The Frogs in Space Update!
notes.content:
[b]New Content[/b]
[list]
[*] Added 6 new items: [spoiler]Sun, Moon, Star, Telescope, Frog, and Jawbreaker[/spoiler].
[*] Added abbreviations for stat numbers when they get large (i.e. instead of damage displaying as 1000000, it should now display 1M)
[*] Added a skip button that appears during endless runs that allows you to simulate an entire encounter without having to manually click.
[*] New, epic [spoiler]frog[/spoiler] graphics!
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where Venus could encounter Pet Leash, Blue Button, and Pawn Shop.
[*] Fixed a bug where Ninja's item description was off center.
[*] Fixed a bug where you couldn't see your Active Item on defeat and victory screens.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.04: Hotfixes #2
notes.content:
[b]New Content[/b]
[list]
[*] New background graphics in the TV room and in item rooms.
[*] Added a toggle in options to turn off particle effects entirely.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.04: Hotfixes #1
notes.content:
[b]New Content[/b]
[list]
[*] Changed the Discord link in the main menu.
[*] Slightly updated graphics in item rooms.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.04: The Active Update!
notes.content:
[b]New Content[/b]
[list]
[*] Added 5 new items: [spoiler]Blue Button, Pet Leash, AAA Battery, Apple Tree, and Pawn Shop[/spoiler].
[*] Added dialogue for the Shopkeeper.
[*] [spoiler]Gnomes[/spoiler] make sounds now.
[*] Updated graphics for [spoiler]cats, rats, and dogs.[/spoiler]
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where Mantis was displaying incorrect values in item descriptions.
[*] Removed Herobrine.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.03: The Garden Update!
notes.content:
[b]New Content[/b]
[list]
[*] Added 14 new items: [spoiler]Gnome, Lawn Mower, Bug Net, Boots, Mantis, Fridge, Bestiary, Rat King, Cat Queen, Dog God, Rat Cage, Cat Tree, Dog House, and Ninja[/spoiler].
[*] Added item "types" to every item in item rooms.
[/list]

[b]Balancing[/b]
[list]
[*] Shuriken now caps off at 2^24 damage.
[*] Re-worded item descriptions for more clarity.
[*] Reverted Venus back to 100 health from 75 health.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where you could go into The Shop/Devil Room with 0 health instead of dying.
[*] Fixed a bug where Berserk wasn't working correctly.
[*] Fixed a bug where dodge chance wasn't being calculated correctly.
[*] Fixed a bug where Venus was ending up in The Shop sometimes.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.02: Hotfixes #2
notes.content:
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where after taking healing multiplier items (Example: Mushroom, Damsel, etc.) at full health would cause you to lose full health.
[*] Fixed an issue where dodge chance wasn't working correctly.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.02: Hotfixes #1
notes.content:
[b]Balancing[/b]
[list]
[*] Re-worked Omar to now start with 3 coins and 0% devil deal chance.
[*] Re-worked Omar's starting item, Cell Phone, to now teleport you to The Shop instantly when used.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where Butterfly wasn't displaying text correctly if it was in the 2nd spot in item rooms.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.02: The Endless Update!
notes.content:
[b]New Content[/b]
[list]
[*] Added an endless mode. Optionally, you can enter endless mode after defeating the final boss to see how far your run can take you!
[*] Added a backpack to the UI, which shows you every item picked up during your run when hovered over.
[*] Added a quick briefing before runs begin.
[*] Added new sounds for Active Items.
[*] Added a new visual after picking up Stonks.
[*] Added 4 new items: [spoiler]Caterpillar, Cocoon, Butterfly, and Recovery[/spoiler].
[*] Reworked [spoiler]Berserker[/spoiler], which now has a completely new effect.
[/list]

[b]Balancing[/b]
[list]
[*] Lowered Venus' starting health to 75 from 100.
[*] Changed up legendary and rare item appearance rates.
[*] TV Remote now gives 1.25x damage ups after skipping The Shop instead of 2x damage ups and has also been moved back to the Rare rarity from Legendary.
[*] TV Dinner now gives a 1.75x health up instead of a 2x health up.
[*] Mask now gives a +2 damage up instead of a +1 damage up when skipping Devil Rooms.
[*] Damsel now gives a 1.25x health up instead of a 1.5x health up.
[*] Mushroom now gives a 1.15x health up instead of a 1.25x health up.
[*] Kiss now gives a +8 health up instead of a +10 health up.
[*] Pillow now gives a +4 health up instead of a +5 health up.
[*] Bubblegum now gives a 1.25x health up instead of a 1.5x health up.
[*] Medkit now costs 16 coins in The Shop instead of 15 coins.
[*] B-ball Bat now costs 8 coins in The Shop instead of 5 coins.
[*] Helmet now gives a 1.15x defense up instead of a 1.25x defense up.
[*] Fatigues now give a 1.25x defense up instead of a 1.5x defense up.
[*] Chocolate now gives a 1.75x defense up instead of a 2x defense up.
[*] Grass Block now gives an additional -0.25 damage down.
[*] Shuriken now starts at 0.25 damage instead of 0.12.
[*] Quick Scope and Toy Robot have both been moved to the Legendary rarity from Rare.
[*] The Envy devil deal now costs 25hp instead of 50hp.
[*] The Gluttony devil deal now costs 40hp instead of 50hp.
[*] The Sloth, Greed, and Fangs devil deals all now cost 60hp instead of 50hp.
[*] Renamed Berserker to Painless and changed the sprite.
[*] Reworded the item descriptions for Turtle Shell and Soda Pop to provide more clarity.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where after taking Spikes, if you went to 0 health right before entering The Shop/The Devil Room, you wouldn't die right away.
[*] Fixed a bug where music wasn't looping correctly in the character select screen and in the options menu.
[*] Fixed a bug where Fangs could appear again after picking it up.
[*] Fixed a bug where shields could display as negative.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.01: Hotfixes #2
notes.content:
[b]New Content[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a new sound effect that plays when using Re-roller.
[*] Added a new sound effect that plays when the Active Item fully recharges.
[*] Added a color spectrum to the Active Item's charge text. The Active Item charge text will now display as green when fully charged, yellow when charging, and red when fully depleted of charge.
[*] Added a visual indicator that displays when the Active Item fully charges.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.01: Hotfixes #1
notes.content:
[b]New Content[/b]
[list]
[*] Added 8 Steam Achievements!
[/list]

[b]Balancing[/b]
[list]
[*] [spoiler]Stonks[/spoiler] is now more punishing on the low end and will go down more often than before.
[*] [spoiler]TV Remote[/spoiler]'s rarity has been changed to Legendary from Rare due to the strength of the item.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the game would not remember the fullscreen toggle option in the options menu.
[*] Fixed an issue where the game would not save music/sound/fullscreen settings if the game was exited in the options menu.
[*] Fixed an issue where the sound played while dragging the sounds slider in the options menu was looping constantly.
[*] Fixed an issue with [spoiler]Rainbow[/spoiler] where it wasn't healing the player when picked up.
[*] Fixed an issue where the character's name was not displaying correctly.
[/list]
